fields.description: Raw workbook value, stored verbatim (ignore_xss_filter) so the report shows exactly what was read. This fieldtype is HTML-escaped by the Desk before it is rendered.
fields.label: Source Text

fields.description: The Persian cell this row tried to write. Stored verbatim (ignore_xss_filter) so the exact rejected value is identifiable, not only the reason.
fields.label: Rejected Persian Value

fields.description: Why the row was not applied. Stored verbatim (ignore_xss_filter) because a reason can quote placeholders and HTML from the workbook.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: What the person can do about it. Stored verbatim (ignore_xss_filter).
fields.label: Suggested Action

fields.description: The exact value Frappe would have received. Stored verbatim (ignore_xss_filter) so a sanitizer finding can be checked against the typed value.
fields.label: Value Before Sanitizing

fields.description: The exact value Frappe would store. Stored verbatim (ignore_xss_filter).
fields.label: Value Frappe Would Store
